app.tagline: Your team's tasks, pinned in one place.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the account your administrator created for you.
login.invalidCredentials: Incorrect username/email or password, or too many attempts. Try again later.
login.noAccount: Don't have an account? Ask your administrator to create one.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.empty: No tasks yet. Add your first one to get started.

attachments.drop: Drop files here or click to upload
attachments.hint: Up to 10 MB per file. Images, PDF, Office documents, CSV, and text.

tasks.archivedNotice: This project is archived, so its tasks are read-only.

comments.title: Comments
comments.subtitle: Discuss this task with your team
comments.empty: No comments yet. Start the conversation.
comments.loginToComment: Sign in to post a comment.

deleteComment.title: Delete this comment?
deleteComment.description: The comment will be permanently removed from the conversation.

removeAttachment.title: Remove this attachment?
removeAttachment.description: The file will be deleted from storage immediately.

deleteTask.title: Delete this task?
deleteTask.description: Attachments and comments on this task will also be removed. This can't be undone.

deleteProject.title: Delete this project?
deleteProject.description: The project and its member list will be removed. This can't be undone.

archiveProject.title: Archive this project?
archiveProject.description: It will be hidden from the sidebar and its tasks become read-only.

removeMember.title: Remove {name} from the project?
removeMember.description: They will no longer see this project or its tasks.

deactivateUser.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivateUser.description: They will be signed out and can't sign in until reactivated. Their tasks and comments stay.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Projects you're a member of
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create the first one to start adding tasks.

form.createHint: You'll be the owner and can add members afterwards.

projectSettings.title: Project settings
projectSettings.membersHint: Only members can see this project and its tasks. Admins can see every project.
projectSettings.archiveHint: Archived projects are hidden from the sidebar and become read-only. You can restore them at any time.
projectSettings.deleteHint: Only projects without tasks can be deleted. Archive projects that have tasks instead.

account.title: My account
account.name: Full name
account.emailHint: Optional. You can sign in with it instead of your username.
account.mustChange: The password you were given is temporary. Choose a new one to continue.

errors.sameAsCurrent: Choose a password different from the current one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.emailTaken: That email is already used by another account.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Create accounts and manage who can sign in

fields.usernameHint: 3–64 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
fields.name: Full name

users.createHint: Share the temporary password with the person privately. They'll choose their own password at first sign-in.
users.resetHint: They'll be signed out everywhere and must choose a new password at next sign-in.

errors.taken: That username or email is already in use.
errors.lastAdmin: At least one active admin is required.
errors.self: You can't remove your own admin access or deactivate yourself.
